summary: A node waiting for peer checkpoint seals reuses its sealed-identity digest until a change it covers lands, instead of walking every envelope on every pass

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index, trigger or migration change; the existing capture epoch and guard rows are used.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests unchanged: a reused digest equals a fresh walk, and any change the capture epoch fences forces a new walk.

compatibility.detail: Same checkpoint status and seals; a waiting step registers its cut with the existing capture guard before reading.

downtime.detail: Normal restart on deploy; the digest memo is in memory and starts empty.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build restores the per-pass walk; nothing is stored.
